findings.problem: Rejecting signed scale<0 rejects legitimate prior output. RangeCalibration::fitScale searches signed corrections; saveSessionState writes the signed result to depth_scales.txt.
findings.normal_counterexample: A valid session chooses a -0.02 correction, publishes its complete bundle, then next session throws Invalid prior depth scale while reading that valid file.
findings.minimal_fix: Preserve finite signed corrections; remove scale<0 rejection. If adding a domain restriction, use the documented multiplicative scale protocol rather than the nonnegative noise-scale domain.
findings.resolution: Parent removed the negative-value rejection; loader now preserves finite signed scale and still rejects nonfinite values. Re-read after change; no tests run.

production_call_chain.contract: Uses strict runner with frame ACK, configured positive backend decision cadence, periodic save=0 and full save=false.
Frame ACK is an active-window processing callback, not a committed-backend decision ACK; later extraction/backend work is drained at finalization.
Frame archive offered before active-window ACK; output evidence ingested before packet reaches downstream. ACK occurs before extractOutputData, so it does not prove downstream completion by itself.
Worker snapshots source under graph lock; sessionCompleteUpdate waits only after releasing that lock, before next backend packet. Same configured requests cannot load-coalesce on this serial path.
Stop input and active window; finishMapping emits remaining extraction output while downstream lives; base stop drains downstream; then finishProcessing.
Wait prior detection, create terminal snapshot with finalize_pending, run surface update, then prepare marker and propagate primary save result into complete session save.
finish callback calls stop then logData; only after save returns marks final saved/clean.
Terminal ACK published only after manager save returns. Missing DDS delivery marks nonzero exit; save exceptions prevent successful ACK.
Each input waits its exact stamp ACK; terminal finish published once, then waits finish_saved. No application-level duplicate save resend.

cmake_contracts.contract: Native target owns baseline sources and includes project OBJECT target once; OpenSSL/zstd linked explicitly.
Project core algorithms and thin member adapters enter khronos once; public headers installed.
Application forces canonical mapper prefixes. SessionBackend and FastDDS contract compile in production node; fingerprint compiles in inspection executable; no duplicate same-target bodies.

bounded_observations: No further concrete normal-input runtime defect established in this scope. The sole confirmed blocker, signed historical scale rejection, was fixed by parent and statically rechecked.

Periodic saves and explicitly disabled detection use different contracts, but the fixed production runner sets periodic save=0 and positive detection cadence; they are not counted as normal-path blockers.
Native LatestOnlyWorker stores failures and waitUntilIdle rethrows. Worker/pipeline failure can terminate the process, but cannot falsely publish a complete successful session ACK.
Source-index growth and final-map memory cost require actual production measurements; no mathematical unbounded-stream argument is used as a finite-session blocker.
Fingerprint ignores winding by construction and is diagnostic; actual persistent package integrity uses SHA256 over the exact saved files, and face-error storage binds exact ordered geometry.
coverage_exclusions: Native dependency bodies are included only at cited inspected call-chain sections, not claimed as a full native algorithm audit. Full session_refusion.cpp was not audited here; only its fitScale/result handoff was read to substantiate RUNTIME-R1.
